provenance.processing: Native spatial subset with separately supplied validity mask; original integer heights retained. No resampling, interpolation, height correction, or CTX modification.
provenance.coverageQualification: 103 x 103 native rectangle around the preserved CTX crop, including 408 border-overhang cells. Bounds are declared grid geometry, not a surveyed route area. Outside support and incomplete metric neighborhoods remain unknown.

model.slope: Central differences of provider DT5 sphere-relative heights divided by source-reference-sphere ground baselines; gradient angle in degrees.
model.roughness: Population standard deviation of valid heights in a complete circular physical-distance neighborhood. Includes broad terrain grade; not rock-scale irregularity.
model.shape: Center height minus neighborhood mean in metres. Not curvature or obstacle detection.
model.costUnit: cost-equivalent-m; a hypothetical preference score, not energy or travel time
model.unknownPolicy: Missing/nonfinite heights always excluded. Incomplete metric support blocked by default; explicit penalize uses distance*unknownCostMultiplier and reports unavailable terrain metrics.
model.search: Eight neighbors, no diagonal corner cutting through excluded flanks or restricted directional flank movements. Contracted source-sphere distance heuristic; all admissible costs are at least horizontal distance.

travelTime.timingModel: Each actual adjacent route segment takes horizontal ground distance / modeled speed. Total duration is the sum of segment times plus the explicit user-defined stationary hold. Cost-equivalent metres are never converted to time.
travelTime.scenarioModel: For each segment: lower duration uses min(maxSpeedMps, estimatedSpeed*(1+speedUncertaintyFraction)); upper duration uses max(minSpeedMps, estimatedSpeed*(1-speedUncertaintyFraction)). Bounds are user-selected sensitivity scenarios, not statistical confidence intervals or validated physical limits.
travelTime.unknownPolicy: Missing heights and blocked movements never yield ETA. The existing terrain policy must explicitly permit incomplete support; such segments use the configured hypothetical unknown speed and retain null unavailable terrain metrics.
travelTime.timeReference: Earth UTC timestamp and SI seconds. No Mars local civil time, sol calendar or live mission clock is inferred.
travelTime.delayModel: Only the explicitly supplied user-defined stationary hold is applied, once after terrain travel. Default is zero. No automatic stops, charging, maintenance, weather or rest schedule.
travelTime.environmentalDelayQualification: No environmental delay model is available; zero applied delay is not evidence of absent environmental effects.
limitations: All presets and vehicle speeds/sensitivities are hypothetical user assumptions; no NASA rover specifications are asserted.
HRSC local physical slope accuracy, terrain uncertainty, precise feature registration and actual traversability remain unverified. ETA is provisional even when all numerical cells are supported.
The existing distance and terrain-cost paths are not optimized for minimum ETA. Faster, shorter or lower cost are distinct objectives.
CTX distance-only routes have no authorized terrain-dependent ETA. No direct-line or constant-speed CTX fallback is supplied.
Step heights, rocks, sand, traction, visibility, weather, thermal and operational limits are not modeled without validated inputs.
The scalar planned hold changes arrival and total duration, not baseline movement speed or segment terrain metrics.
Sphere-relative provider DEM model. Physical slope accuracy, local uncertainty, precise feature registration, hazards, and rover/human safety remain unverified.
Physical Mars slopes, terrain costs, actual traversability, safety and precise named-feature routing remain unverified. These paths are hypothetical native-grid model outputs.
50 m projected grid spacing and 1 m quantization do not establish local effective resolution or horizontal/vertical accuracy. Step heights, rocks, sand traps and hazards are not detected.
No original per-cell stereo/support-quality mask is available. A valid numerical sample is not a measurement-quality or traversability guarantee.
HRSC is part of CTX control lineage. It is not independent ground truth and does not resolve the CTX final vertical equation, correction sign or spatially varying transformation.
CTX endpoints are mapped by longitude/latitude to containing HRSC cells, then use HRSC centers. This snap is not empirical imagery/DEM co-registration.
Blocked search cells count all model cells exceeding assumptions, not obstacles proven avoided. Expanded cells represent search work, not measured coverage quality.
Exact acquisition contributors, crop-specific error estimates and scientific release version remain unknown. HTTP modification validators are not acquisition dates.
Independent prototype; not NASA endorsed or a certified human-safety system.
